description: tikajs-f301: the shape of Grizzly corpora-pdf-x000/00237 (Skia output, damaged by cutting key and value endings), small and synthetic: a Type0/CIDFontType2 font with an embedded TrueType program whose /Subtype is /Type, /Encoding /Identity-, /CIDToGIDMap one character short and whose /W lost its name, shown with flipped text matrices and Td-separated pieces. Read as a simple font the glyphs came out one to a line; with the widths lost (/DW 0, no /W) the gap before a piece is not seen and 'H oe' reads 'Hoe'. The rebuild puts the font right (step font-repaired, key repair of tikajs-1myi), so the text reads whole, spaces included.
